items.title: Feds suspect ransom negotiator ran ShinyHunters extortion site
items.summary: 📝 federal investigators pursuing the ShinyHunters hacking group that recently stole highly sensitive data from the FBI have identified executives at two different ransomware negotiation firms who maintained unusually close relations with the extortion group, KrebsOnSecurity has learned. On October 9, KrebsOnSecurity broke the news that the FBI arrested a 54-year-old Canadian cybersecurity executive named Edward Dubrovsky in connection with the ShinyHunters investigation. items.title: Benchmarking Bot Detection Systems Against Modern AI Agents in 2026
items.summary: 📝 We revisit our bot detection benchmark with stealth browsers and modern AI agents, and find detection rates ranging from 9% to 99%. Detection rates varied substantially, ranging from 33% to 87%. We found that detection performance varied substantially across systems.🔗 Read more: https://research.poh.org/bot-benchmarking-2026/

items.title: Claude designed protein binders against scorpion neurotoxins
items.summary: 📝 Claude worked from our prompt and four follow-ups, which we developed in collaboration with the financial investment research firm Citrini Research. We landed on asking for Claude’s help designing novel protein binders against scorpion neurotoxins, with the hope that they could one day be used to develop a scorpion antivenom. Designing de novo binders against five toxins from four species of scorpionsScorpion venom contains multiple protein neurotoxins.🔗 Read more: https://www.anthropic.com/research/claude-scorpion-toxin-binder-design
